source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blood group systems (PDF 92).

blocks.text: Blood group system khoon ko red blood cells (RBCs) par khaas antigens ki maujoodgi se taqseem karta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq International Society of Blood Transfusion insanon mein 43 blood group systems tasleem karti hai, aur har nizam ke apne blood groups hain.

Sab se ahem ABO system (groups A, B, AB aur O) hai, aur doosra Rh system (Rh-positive aur Rh-negative). Khoon chadhane (transfusion) ke liye dene wale (donor) aur lene wale (recipient) ke ABO aur Rh groups milne chahiyen.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Red cells ki satah ke woh antigens jo blood groups tay karte hain proteins, carbohydrates, glycoproteins ya glycolipids ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Transfusion se pehle kaun se do blood group systems milane zaroori hain?

items: Blood groups red cells ke antigens se tay hote hain.
ABO sab se ahem aur Rh doosra nizam hai.
